methodology.policy: BOBCAT straight-through bilevel optimization, local NCD meta-learner
methodology.policy_training: 100 fixed epochs by default; outer-train learners only; no test tuning
methodology.policy_support_query: per-learner seeded 80/20 item split inside outer train
methodology.final_scoring: same per-seed NCD checkpoint, 10 epochs, batch 64, tau=0
methodology.query: 70 unadministered questions per learner; IDs may differ by method
methodology.constraints: BOBCAT/Random individual items; PCAT/Fixed whole TOEIC bundles
methodology.random: uniform 20 distinct items per learner, mean of 3 repetitions per split
methodology.fixed: saved PCAT medium+easy paper; not independently optimized
methodology.timing: CPU wall time per test cohort; model loading excluded; no real exam UI/I/O
